extracted.title: Simhastha flag-hoisting reported for 31 October 2026; President's attendance described as likely
extracted.summary: The Simhastha is reported to open with a flag-hoisting at Ramkund, Nashik, and Kushavarta Tirtha, Trimbakeshwar, on 31 October 2026. Press coverage describes the President's attendance as likely, not confirmed. Traffic, parking and security arrangements for the day were reported as under preparation.
